name: GAMES POLISH WAVE — juice audit + patch drafts, top 10

Return ONE highest-value polish patch as complete JS/CSS code with exact insertion points (function/line context), plus expected player-facing effect. No rewrites — one surgical patch. Cite the code you're patching.
